summary: Created opsbot on node1 and node2 (password locked), generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key as opsbot's authorized_key on node2, and added an sshd Match User opsbot drop-in on both nodes requiring PubkeyAuthentication only (PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication disabled, AuthenticationMethods publickey). Verified opsbot@node1 can SSH into opsbot@node2 with keys and that password/keyboard-interactive auth is rejected on both nodes. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot IDs, rebooted node1 then node2 one at a time (never concurrently), polled each until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and reverified sshd health, opsbot account/keys, and pubkey-only enforcement plus cross-node SSH after each restart.

Inspected sshd_config defaults on both nodes (cmd-ad5440444b224fb2, cmd-33549537572e47b9)
Added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-opsbot.conf Match User opsbot block enforcing publickey-only auth and reloaded sshd on node1 (cmd-80fa0226d68a4fc3) and node2 (cmd-17fa52d4ced641a8)
Verified opsbot@node1 -> opsbot@node2 key-based SSH works (cmd-316f399536d94ed7)

Verified node2 post-restart recovery: sshd active, opsbot/authorized_keys intact, pubkey-only policy still enforced (cmd-5ca35c0f188c4679), and cross-node key-based SSH works while password auth is still rejected (cmd-de194e158acc4346)

evidence.requirement: opsbot account created on node1 and node2
evidence.summary: useradd succeeded on both nodes; id opsbot shows uid=1000(opsbot) on each with password locked via passwd -l

evidence.requirement: opsbot on node1 has SSH key-based access to run commands as opsbot on node2
evidence.summary: Generated ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed its public key into opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and confirmed opsbot@node1 can BatchMode-SSH (key only) into opsbot@node2 and run whoami/hostname successfully

evidence.requirement: key-based authentication required for opsbot on both systems (password/interactive auth rejected)
evidence.summary: Added Match User opsbot sshd drop-in on both nodes setting PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication no and AuthenticationMethods publickey; sshd -T -C user=opsbot confirms effective policy on both nodes; forcing PreferredAuthentications=password from node1 to node2 was rejected with 'Permission denied (publickey)'
